description: What visitors do on one page after they land (PostKing's "After they land" panel): how long they stay, how far down they read, which section they leave in, and which buttons they click. Returns plain-language `suggestions` first (what to change on the page), then a compact `summary` (visits, avgSeconds, readHalfwayPct, clicksPer100Visits, timeOnPagePct), per-`sections` reach and drop-off (reachedPct, leftHerePct, goneSoFarPct, clickedPer100Visits), per-`ctas` click rates, and `pages` (the other tracked pages you can inspect). Pass `host` + `path` (as listed in `pages`) for a specific page; omit both for the most-visited page. `days` is 1-365 (default 28). Free. Use it after a landing-page change to see whether visitors behave differently, and before editing a page to see where to focus. Pages served by PostKing are tracked automatically. If the site is hosted elsewhere and nothing is tracked yet, `install` returns the tracking snippet and a brief for whoever builds the site. `limit` (default 15, max 50) caps the sections, ctas and pages lists.

host.description: Host of the page, as listed in `pages`. Omit for the most-visited page.

limit.description: Max rows in each of sections, ctas and pages (default 15, max 50).

path.description: Path of the page, e.g. "/pricing". Omit for the most-visited page.
